P002 combines the initial-access event with persistence establishment. Initial access is separately summarized in P001/P005, while specific persistence mechanisms are detailed in P006; consider separating the actions to avoid duplicating access and to keep persistence evidence precise.

P021 broadly says Stowaway was used to establish C2; P024 describes downloading a modified Stowaway and successfully establishing the outbound C2 connection on the same page. These may be duplicate descriptions of the same connection; retain distinct download evidence if merged.

The timeline calls this initial access to the SQL Server, while the report narrative describes the actors moving laterally to the SQL Server. Preserve the event but resolve the wording or scope; the timeline alone supplies no method to map.
